purpose: One row per distinct tool across the project catalog (projects/limpet/tool-catalog.json, 104 tools), the foreman catalog (limpet/tool-catalog.json, 44 tools) and the tool names used by projects/limpet/data/*.toml, with a verified install_method and package. Stage 4 of the ISO build reads install_method/package from limpet/tool-catalog.json; this file carries the same decision for the tools that are not in the foreman catalog yet.

limpet_iso_classification.note: Automated first pass (agent limpet-iso-6302d0); limpet_iso_class on each row is its verdict. Every NEEDS-EYEBALL row was re-checked here against PyPI/npm/crates.io metadata, apt-cache, and GitHub release assets.

install_method_vocabulary.apt: Ubuntu 26.04 archive package; package = apt package name.
install_method_vocabulary.pip: PyPI distribution whose metadata points at the upstream repo, or a pip requirement spec (git+URL); package = that spec.
install_method_vocabulary.npm: npm package whose repository field points at the upstream repo; package = npm name.
install_method_vocabulary.cargo: crates.io crate whose repository points at the upstream repo; package = crate name.
install_method_vocabulary.binary: Prebuilt upstream release artifact; package = asset filename at the latest release checked.
install_method_vocabulary.source-build: Fetch from the upstream source repo, building if needed; package = repo URL.
install_method_vocabulary.container: Upstream ships as a container image built from its repo; package = repo URL.
install_method_vocabulary.vendor: Proprietary or vendor-distributed, or needs a proprietary host (IDA, Binary Ninja, Windows); package = null.
install_method_vocabulary.hardware: Physical device or probe firmware; no host package (host-side tools are listed separately); package = null.
install_method_vocabulary.limpet-native: Limpet's own plugin; ships with Limpet, no upstream package; package = null.
install_method_vocabulary.unresolved: No verified upstream; never guessed; package = null until someone verifies one.
